privateBrowserFocusSetup.scope: Official private native focus fixture setup before layout capture; not a real click or feature acceptance
privateBrowserFocusSetup.command:
do
local w=hl.get_window("address:0x65227221a010")
assert(w,"Exact captured private Browser absent")
local a,s,p=hl.plugin.hyprbars.window_lifetime(w)
assert(a=="0x65227221a010" and s=="18000000" and p==2234529,"Private Browser lifetime changed before focus setup")
local result=hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.focus({window="address:0x65227221a010"}))
local z=hl.get_window("address:0x65227221a010")
assert(z,"Exact captured private Browser absent after focus setup")
local aa,ss,pp=hl.plugin.hyprbars.window_lifetime(z)
assert(aa==a and ss==s and pp==p,"Private Browser lifetime changed during focus setup")
local fields={}
if type(result)=="table" then
 for k,v in pairs(result) do fields[#fields+1]=tostring(k).."="..tostring(v) end
 table.sort(fields)
end
print("qa-browser-focus-setup-result:"..type(result)..":"..table.concat(fields,","))
print("qa-browser-focus-setup-ack:0x65227221a010:18000000:2234529")
end

focusSetup.command:
do
local w=hl.get_window("address:0x65227221a010")
assert(w,"Exact captured private Browser absent")
local a,s,p=hl.plugin.hyprbars.window_lifetime(w)
assert(a=="0x65227221a010" and s=="18000000" and p==2234529,"Private Browser lifetime changed before focus setup")
local result=hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.focus({window="address:0x65227221a010"}))
local z=hl.get_window("address:0x65227221a010")
assert(z,"Exact captured private Browser absent after focus setup")
local aa,ss,pp=hl.plugin.hyprbars.window_lifetime(z)
assert(aa==a and ss==s and pp==p,"Private Browser lifetime changed during focus setup")
local fields={}
if type(result)=="table" then
 for k,v in pairs(result) do fields[#fields+1]=tostring(k).."="..tostring(v) end
 table.sort(fields)
end
print("qa-browser-focus-setup-result:"..type(result)..":"..table.concat(fields,","))
print("qa-browser-focus-setup-ack:0x65227221a010:18000000:2234529")
end
